status: Release approved 2026-10-12. Deployment outcome is tracked by the GitHub commit's Vercel status.

policy.sharpEdge: Direct C in these two components per explicit manager policy; other safety/functional repair rules unchanged
policy.closing: Slight bend with normal closing C; cannot close requires direct repair, grade withheld until repair
policy.history: No saved records are rewritten. Old broken-cover repair fallback retained. Pre-policy unfinished guided drafts are not restored.
policy.entryQuestions: Bovenkap C first chooses wear versus structural damage. Lid and edge X entry questions contain no C options. Side C -> broken edge offers <=3 C versus >3 X. Faulty ports appear only under side X, require testing and direct repair.
policy.ports: Test the actual ports; visual damage example cannot establish functionality. Confirmed faulty ports use direct repair, not cosmetic C.
policy.bottomCover: Break or missing opening at greatest span <=5 cm C, >5 cm direct repair/X. Safety risk independent of size. C and X broken-bottom entries require measurement.
policy.palmrest: C asks four observations: heavy scratches, sticky coating/paint, fracture, missing corner. Last two require greatest-span measurement <=3cm C / >3cm reject-X. X only large fractures, large missing corner and independent safety risk. Historical Palmrest gebroken/hoek ontbreekt fallback retains previous C after repair.
policy.bezel: Clear cracks / heavy breakage is C (30 points). X offers only a loose bezel (direct repair) or dangerous sharp edge (reject). Historical broken-bezel repair records retain C after repair; saved records are not rewritten.

photoNote: AI examples are illustrative, not calibrated measurements; measure the real laptop, never infer cm from photo size.
